cases.sentence: ты теперь переходишь через ___, чтобы войти и выселить народы
cases.translation: you are now crossing the Jordan to go in and dispossess nations
cases.explain: The preposition 'через' (through/across) governs the accusative case to express movement across a boundary.

cases.sentence: Люди те сильные и высокие, потомки ___
cases.translation: These are a mighty and tall people, descendants of Anak
cases.explain: The genitive case is used in the construction 'потомки Анака' (descendants of Anak) to show possession.

cases.sentence: Но будь уверен, Господь твой Бог пойдет перед тобой, подобно пожирающему ___
cases.translation: but know that the Lord your God goes before you like a devouring fire
cases.explain: The preposition 'подобно' with dative case expresses comparison or likeness.

cases.sentence: не говори себе За мою праведность Господь привел меня сюда, чтобы я овладел этой ___
cases.translation: do not say in your heart, 'Because of my righteousness the Lord has brought me to possess this land'
cases.explain: The verb 'овладел' (to gain possession of) governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: No, it is because of the wickedness of these nations
cases.explain: The preposition 'из-за' (because of) governs the genitive case to express cause or reason.

cases.sentence: чтобы исполнить то, о чем он клялся твоим отцам Аврааму, Исааку и ___
cases.translation: to fulfill the oath which He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob
cases.explain: The verb 'клялся' (swore) with dative case indicates the person to whom an oath is made.

cases.sentence: Когда я поднялся на гору, чтобы получить каменные плитки, плитки ___
cases.translation: When I went up on the mountain to receive the stone tablets, the tablets of the covenant
cases.explain: The genitive case is used in 'плитки завета' (tablets of the covenant) showing what the tablets contain.
The genitive case is used with the negative verb 'не ел' (did not eat) for the partitive or complete negation.

reading.ru: Слушай, Израиль, ты теперь переходишь через Иордан, чтобы войти и выселить народы, которые больше и сильнее тебя, с большими городами, чьи стены до неба.
reading.question: What challenge faces the Israelites as they prepare to cross the Jordan?
options: The Jordan river is too wide to cross
They must dispossess nations stronger than themselves with walled cities
The climate is too harsh for survival
reading.correct: They must dispossess nations stronger than themselves with walled cities
reading.explain: The text describes nations 'больше и сильнее тебя' (greater and mightier than you) with 'большими городами, чьи стены до неба' (great cities with walls that reach to the sky).

reading.ru: Но будь уверен, Господь твой Бог пойдет перед тобой, подобно пожирающему огню.
reading.question: What will the Lord do to help you against these nations?
options: Give you superior weapons and armor
Go before you like a devouring fire
Make you invisible to your enemies
Send an army of angels to fight for you
reading.correct: Go before you like a devouring fire
reading.explain: The text states 'Господь твой Бог пойдет перед тобой, подобно пожирающему огню' (the Lord will go before you like a devouring fire).

reading.ru: не говори себе За мою праведность Господь привел меня сюда, чтобы я овладел этой землей.
reading.question: What false assumption should you not make about receiving the land?
options: That you bought it with money
That it was your own righteousness that brought you to possess it
That you were stronger than other nations
That the land will last forever
reading.correct: That it was your own righteousness that brought you to possess it
reading.explain: The text warns 'не говори себе За мою праведность Господь привел меня' (do not say 'Because of my righteousness the Lord brought me').

reading.ru: Нет, из-за нечестия этих народов Господь собирается прогнать их от тебя.
reading.question: Why will God dispossess these nations in your favor?
options: Because of the wickedness of these nations
Because you are stronger than them
Because you will pay tribute to God
reading.correct: Because of the wickedness of these nations
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'из-за нечестия этих народов Господь собирается прогнать их' (because of the wickedness of these nations the Lord will drive them out).

reading.ru: Я провел на горе сорок дней и сорок ночей, я не ел хлеба и не пил воды.
reading.question: How long did Moses spend on the mountain receiving the Law from God?
options: Forty days and forty nights without food or water
reading.correct: Forty days and forty nights without food or water
reading.explain: The text states 'Я провел на горе сорок дней и сорок ночей. Я не ел хлеба и не пил воды' (I spent forty days and nights on the mountain; I did not eat bread or drink water).

reading.ru: Знай, что не за твою праведность Господь твой Бог отдает тебе во владение эту благодатную землю, ведь ты упрямый народ.
reading.question: What is said about Israel's character in relation to receiving the land?
options: They are a very righteous people deserving reward
They are a stiff-necked people, not receiving the land because of their righteousness
They are the most obedient of all nations
They are the wisest people on earth
reading.correct: They are a stiff-necked people, not receiving the land because of their righteousness
reading.explain: The text states 'не за твою праведность... ведь ты упрямый народ' (not because of your righteousness, for you are a stiff-necked people).
